lines.gurmukhi: ਦਇਆ ਕਰਹੁ ਕਿਰਮ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕਉ ਇਹੈ ਮਨੋਰਥੁ ਸੁਆਉ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: daiaa karahu kiram apune kau ihai manorath suaau ||2||
lines.translation: Please, be kind to me - I am just a worm. This is my object and purpose. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਤੂੰ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਮਰੈ ਵਸਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: tan dhan teraa too(n) prabh meraa hamarai vas kichh naahi ||
lines.translation: My body and wealth are Yours; You are my God - nothing is in my power.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਜਿਉ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਤਿਉ ਤਿਉ ਰਹਣਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਦੀਆ ਖਾਹਿ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: jiu jiu raakhahi tiu tiu rahanaa teraa deeaa khaahi ||3||
lines.translation: As You keep me, so do I live; I eat what You give me. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਕਾਟੈ ਮਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਧੂਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: janam janam ke kilavikh kaatai majan har jan dhoor ||
lines.translation: The sins of countless incarnations are washed away, by bathing in the dust of the Lord's humble servants.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਰਮ ਭਉ ਨਾਸੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦਾ ਹਜੂਰਿ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੩੯॥
lines.transliteration: bhaai bhagat bharam bhau naasai har naanak sadaa hajoor ||4||4||139||
lines.translation: By loving devotional worship, doubt and fear depart; O Nanak, the Lord is Ever-present. ||4||4||139||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਦਰਸੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: agam agochar daras teraa so paae jis masatak bhaag ||
lines.translation: The Blessed Vision of Your Darshan is unapproachable and incomprehensible; he alone obtains it, who has such good destiny recorded upon his forehead.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਧਾਰੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਬਖਸਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: aap kripaal kripaa prabh dhaaree satigur bakhasiaa har naam ||1||
lines.translation: The Merciful Lord God has bestowed His Mercy, and the True Guru has granted the Lord's Name. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਲਿਜੁਗੁ ਉਧਾਰਿਆ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ॥
lines.transliteration: kalijug udhaariaa guradev ||
lines.translation: The Divine Guru is the Saving Grace in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਲ ਮੂਤ ਮੂੜ ਜਿ ਮੁਘਦ ਹੋਤੇ ਸਭਿ ਲਗੇ ਤੇਰੀ ਸੇਵ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: mal moot mooR j mughad hote sabh lage teree sev ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Even those fools and idiots, stained with feces and urine, have all taken to Your service. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਸਭ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਧਰਤਾ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: too aap karataa sabh srisat dharataa sabh mahi rahiaa samaai ||
lines.translation: You Yourself are the Creator, who established the entire world. You are contained in all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਰਮ ਰਾਜਾ ਬਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਹੋਆ ਸਭ ਪਈ ਪੈਰੀ ਆਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: dharam raajaa bisamaad hoaa sabh paee pairee aai ||2||
lines.translation: The Righteous Judge of Dharma is wonder-struck, at the sight of everyone falling at the Lord's Feet. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਜੁਗੁ ਤ੍ਰੇਤਾ ਦੁਆਪਰੁ ਭਣੀਐ ਕਲਿਜੁਗੁ ਊਤਮੋ ਜੁਗਾ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: satajug tretaa duaapar bhaneeai kalijug ootamo jugaa maahi ||
lines.translation: The Golden Age of Sat Yuga, the Silver Age of Trayta Yuga, and the Brass Age of Dwaapar Yuga are good; but the best is the Dark Age, the Iron Age, of Kali Yuga.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਹਿ ਕਰੁ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਅਹਿ ਕਰੁ ਪਾਏ ਕੋਈ ਨ ਪਕੜੀਐ ਕਿਸੈ ਥਾਇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: ahi kar kare s ahi kar paae koee na pakaReeai kisai thaai ||3||
lines.translation: As we act, so are the rewards we receive; no one can take the place of another. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸੋਈ ਕਰਹਿ ਜਿ ਭਗਤ ਤੇਰੇ ਜਾਚਹਿ ਏਹੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਬਿਰਦੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: har jeeu soee karahi j bhagat tere jaachahi ehu teraa birad ||
lines.translation: O Dear Lord, whatever Your devotees ask for, You do. This is Your Way, Your very nature.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਨੁ ਮਾਗੈ ਅਪਣਿਆ ਸੰਤਾ ਦੇਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸੁ ॥੪॥੫॥੧੪੦॥
lines.transliteration: kar joR naanak daan maagai apaniaa sa(n)taa dehi har daras ||4||5||140||
lines.translation: With my palms pressed together, O Nanak, I beg for this gift; Lord, please bless Your Saints with Your Vision. ||4||5||140||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੧੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: raag aasaa mahalaa 5 ghar 13 ||
lines.translation: Raag Aasaa, Fifth Mehl, Thirteenth House:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਚਨ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur bachan tumhaare ||
lines.translation: O True Guru, by Your Words,

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: niragun nisataare ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: even the worthless have been saved. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਬਿਖਾਦੀ ਦੁਸਟ ਅਪਵਾਦੀ ਤੇ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਸੰਗਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: mahaa bikhaadee dusat apavaadee te puneet sa(n)gaare ||1||
lines.translation: Even the most argumentative, vicious and indecent people, have been purified in Your company. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਭਵੰਤੇ ਨਰਕਿ ਪੜੰਤੇ ਤਿਨੑ ਕੇ ਕੁਲ ਉਧਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: janam bhava(n)te narak paRa(n)te tinh ke kul udhaare ||2||
lines.translation: Those who have wandered in reincarnation, and those who have been consigned to hell - even their families have been redeemed. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮਾਨੈ ਸੇ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹਰਿ ਦੁਆਰੇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: koi na jaanai koi na maanai se paragat har duaare ||3||
lines.translation: Those whom no one knew, and those whom no one respected - even they have become famous and respected at the Court of the Lord. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਵਨ ਉਪਮਾ ਦੇਉ ਕਵਨ ਵਡਾਈ ਨਾਨਕ ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਵਾਰੇ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੪੧॥
lines.transliteration: kavan upamaa deu kavan vadaaee naanak khin khin vaare ||4||1||141||
lines.translation: What praise, and what greatness should I attribute to You? Nanak is a sacrifice to You, each and every moment. ||4||1||141||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਵਰ ਸੋਇ ਰਹੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: baavar soi rahe ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The crazy people are asleep. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੋਹ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਬਿਖੈ ਰਸ ਮਾਤੇ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਗਹਨ ਗਹੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: moh kuta(n)b bikhai ras maate mithiaa gahan gahe ||1||
lines.translation: They are intoxicated with attachment to their families and sensory pleasures; they are held in the grip of falsehood. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਿਥਨ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਸੁਪਨ ਆਨੰਦ ਉਲਾਸ ਮਨਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਸਤਿ ਕਹੇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: mithan manorath supan aana(n)d ulaas man mukh sat kahe ||2||
lines.translation: The false desires, and the dream-like delights and pleasures - these, the self-willed manmukhs call true. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਸੰਗੇ ਤਿਲੁ ਮਰਮੁ ਨ ਲਹੇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)mrit naam padaarath sa(n)ge til maram na lahe ||3||
lines.translation: The wealth of the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord, is with them, but they do not find even a tiny bit of its mystery. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਰਾਖੇ ਸਤਸੰਗੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਆਹੇ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੪੨॥
lines.transliteration: kar kirapaa raakhe satasa(n)ge naanak saran aahe ||4||2||142||
lines.translation: By Your Grace, O Lord, You save those, who take to the Sanctuary of the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation. ||4||2||142||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਤਿਪਦੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 tipade ||
lines.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl, Thi-Padhay:

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਹਾ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਿਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: ohaa prem piree ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: I seek the Love of my Beloved. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਨਿਕ ਮਾਣਿਕ ਗਜ ਮੋਤੀਅਨ ਲਾਲਨ ਨਹ ਨਾਹ ਨਹੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: kanik maanik gaj moteean laalan nah naah nahee ||1||
lines.translation: Gold, jewels, giant pearls and rubies - I have no need for them. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਜ ਨ ਭਾਗ ਨ ਹੁਕਮ ਨ ਸਾਦਨ ॥ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਨ ਚਾਹੀ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: raaj na bhaag na hukam na saadan || kichh kichh na chaahee ||2||
lines.translation: Imperial power, fortunes, royal command and mansions - I have no desire for these. ||2||
